Step 1: Serving framework calls aiter MLA decode - paged KV cache block table ready
Step 2: Lookup tuned config for MI300X/MI355X + model shape - select ASM or Triton backend
Step 3: @compile_ops JIT cache hit or compile hand-tuned AMDGCN MFMA kernel to .so
Step 4: Latent Q/K/V projection + RoPE + paged attention decode on gfx942/gfx950
Step 5: Output tokens to framework - fused MoE/GEMM/RMSNorm chain continues in AITER
DeepSeek-R1 e2e SGLang: 6484 to 13704 tok/s (2.1x) with full AITER operator stack on MI300X
MHA prefill: up to 14x - Block-scaled Fused MoE: up to 3x - Block-scaled GEMM: up to 2x
Run op_tests: python3 op_tests/test_mla.py test_mha.py test_moe.py test_gemm_a8w8.py
AMD ROCm AI operator layer - cuDNN-equivalent role for LLM inference/training on Instinct GPUs
git clone --recursive ROCm/aiter - python3 setup.py develop - import aiter
Design Position (AMD ROCm AI operator layer - heterogeneous backends per op beats single-language kernel repos)
Triton + CK + HIP + ASM + JIT compile_ops = default production LLM kernel backend for vLLM/SGLang on MI300/MI350
Init: git clone --recursive - setup.py develop - FlyDSL + AMD triton auto-installed - optional Iris comm via requirements-triton-comms
Loop: framework op call - compile_ops cache - backend dispatch - JIT if miss - HIP launch - reuse cached .so
